PowerMode to be able to react or answer on any DoIP message, it shall obtain it, by calling the method ara::diag::DoIPPowerMode:: GetDoIPPowerMode . ⌋ [SWS_DM_01525] ara::diag::DoIPPowerMode not yet offered when client re- quests DoIP PowerMode Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_00080 ⌈ If a client requests the DoIP power mode information, the DM shall send a DoIP power mode information response with power mode value 0 ("Not ready"), as long as the Offer function of the ara::diag::DoIPPowerMode interface is not called yet by the Adaptive Application, that provides it (as defined in the ISO 13400-2[2] specification). ⌋ [SWS_DM_00813] Providing the GID in DoIP protocol messages using applica- tion interface Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_00026 ⌈ If DoIpInstantiation.gid is not configured,
